 Summary
 Madueke levels with Arsenal's first shot of the second half
 Newcastle had improved in second half to come from behind to lead
 Eze fires Arsenal ahead with first-time finish, Odegaard error ends in Barnes levelling and Thiaw pokes in

 Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal 
 Harvey Barnes sticks it through the legs of Declan Rice and hits the deck. It looks a foul but the referee waves play on.

 'Great pace by Barnes' published at 19:26 GMT 19:26 GMT 
 Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Scotland winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It is one of those that went so high it makes you wonder did it bobble in front of Jacob Ramsey. 
 A bit harsh on them, but great pace shown by Barnes, he left Declan Rice for dead.

 'Ramsey should do better' published at 19:25 GMT 19:25 GMT 
 Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on Sky Sports 
 Jacob Ramsey should do better, he knows it.
 It's a brilliant opportunity.
 Ramsey has got to work the goalkeeper in that situation.
 A chance for Newcastle to nick it not taken.

 'Newcastle aren't settling just for a point' published at 19:20 GMT 19:20 GMT 
 Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Scotland winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 This has got the feeling of a cup tie. 
 I love that Newcastle don't want to settle just for a point against the champions. 
 But I think they're running out of players, Lewis Hall has sat down.

 Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Scotland winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 I've watched so many late winners at this ground against Newcastle. 
 But the way they've played today they're just as likely to score a goal themselves. 
 Arsenal are growing back into it.
